review.brief: Review the diff of commit d75c55b only. Validate: (1) boundaries — internal/charging plus TWO granted paths: internal/analytics/recalculate.go (task 4.1 only) and kkpa/context/architecture/nightly-cycle.md (task 3.1). Nothing else. Note: make boundary-guard only checks that gateway does not import telemetry, so it does NOT validate task 4.1's cross-module edit — you must judge that boundary by reading. (2) code-comment rule — no design.md, decision-ID, change-ID or tier citation in any comment this change wrote, including the doc comment the worker cleaned in NewSuperchargerSessionAnalyticsReader; (3) D3 is the highest-risk item — NewSuperchargerSessionAnalyticsReader must be wrapped and NewSessionReader must be byte-for-byte unchanged. Both return the same concrete type. Wrapping both would log every Supercharger stats page render; (4) D1, D2 — Writer, SessionReader and SessionVerifier have NO decorator at all, not a silent one; (5) D7 — every format string, argument order and before/after delegation choice matches the table; (6) D10 / task 4.1 — the line is in Recalculate, logs AFTER the read, reports len(entries), and its topic is exactly 'manual entries read:', NOT charging query: and NOT analytics query:; (7) D9 — no decorator transforms a result or error; no credential or raw payload is logged; (8) task 3.1's KB prose is correct and written for a reader who never saw this change; (9) tasks.md coverage; (10) no test file — RD1 excludes tests, a missing test is NOT a finding; (11) anti-gaming. IMPORTANT: the working tree carries UNRELATED uncommitted work by the owner in internal/analytics/{analytics,consumed,consumption}.go, two analytics test files, internal/gateway/templates/fragments/dashboard_vm.go, and two kkpa/context guides. That work is NOT part of this change and must NOT be reviewed or reported. Review the commit's diff, not the working tree. Signals: go build, go vet, gofmt -l, make lint (0 issues) and make boundary-guard were ASSISTANT-run, but over a tree that also held that unrelated work, so they are not a clean statement about this change alone. make test was USER-run and reported passing by the user. Judge test quality by reading, never by running.
